title: CORDI vs CORE-RHEE — LONDON vs SYDNEY
style: uk grime, aussie drill, 140 bpm, gritty 808s, sub bass, hi-hat rolls, london siren, sydney horn stab, double-time flow, viral tiktok hook, call-and-response, two-MC trade-off, bar-for-bar war, drill snares, grime square-wave lead, deep brixton sub, bondi sun-bleached snare
lyrics:
[Intro — DJ Zynrose tag, vinyl crackle]
Zynrose said spin and drop…
Three names, one legend, watch the borders pop…

[Hook — chant, viral TikTok 8-bar]
CORDI! CORE-RHEE! CORDI! COR-DI!
London to Sydney, who you wanna be?
CORDI! CORE-RHEE! CORDI! COR-DI!
Three names same passport, that’s the prophecy!

[Verse 1 — CORDI, London grime, fast double-time]
Oi bruv it’s Cordi, on the Thames in a black cab,
Peng ting on the link, innit fam, that’s a mad jab,
Brixton to Bondi, I’m the bridge in the slang lab,
Kebab in me left hand, mic check, grab the hand-grab,
Gully like the Old Kent, sub heavy like the night bus,
Man dem in the cypher, every borough wanna ride us,
From the chicken shop cypher to the ABC in the cyclone,
Cordi run the underground, Zynrose run the dial tone.

[Hook]
CORDI! CORE-RHEE! CORDI! COR-DI!
London to Sydney, who you wanna be?
CORDI! CORE-RHEE! CORDI! COR-DI!
Three names same passport, that’s the prophecy!

[Verse 2 — CORE-RHEE, Sydney drill, slower pocket, deeper voice]
Oi mate it’s Core-Rhee, sick c’z on the harbour,
Deadly bro on the deck, southern cross sharper,
Bondi sand in me Air Force, surf to the studio,
Meat pie in me right hand, sauce drip, that’s the audio,
Kings Cross to the Cross-Bronx, Tasman to the Atlantic,
Sydney drill don’t panic, every bar is gigantic,
Cordi got the grime tongue, I got the drill thunder,
Same bloke different postcode, watch the whole world wonder.

[Bridge — trade-off, 1 word each, fast]
CORDI: Innit —
CORE-RHEE: Yeah nah —
CORDI: Peng —
CORE-RHEE: Sick —
CORDI: Bruv —
CORE-RHEE: Mate —
CORDI: Brixton —
CORE-RHEE: Bondi —
BOTH: SAME LEGEND!

[Hook — double-time, ad-libs]
CORDI! (oi!) CORE-RHEE! (mate!) CORDI! (innit!) COR-DI! (sick!)
London to Sydney, who you wanna be?
CORDI! (peng!) CORE-RHEE! (deadly!) CORDI! (gully!) COR-DI! (choice!)
Three names same passport, that’s the prophecy!

[Verse 3 — split bars, both MCs alternating every line]
CORDI: Thames water cold, but the bars stay hotter,
CORE-RHEE: Tasman wave taller, every flow a slaughter,
CORDI: Cordi in the cypher with a pirate FM blaze,
CORE-RHEE: Core-Rhee in the bush with a kookaburra craze,
CORDI: Boris bike to the booth, no time for the queue,
CORE-RHEE: Tinny on the harbour, I’m as Aussie as the brew,
CORDI: Roses in the static —
CORE-RHEE: Mansion on the keel —
BOTH: Three names, one legend, this is how the bars feel!

[Outro — DJ Zynrose, fade]
Zynrose on the spin… drop the borders, drop the doubt…
Cordi, Core-Rhee, Corey — same beating heart, mate —
from the Thames to the Tasman, the rap-off don’t stop…
(spin and drop… spin and drop… spin and drop…)
[end]
